register_engine: register a new engine class in the VISSL engine registry using the @register_engine decorator
get_engine: retrieve an engine instance from the registry by its registered name
run_engine: run a registered engine with configuration, checkpoint paths, and distributed training parameters
create_engine_subclass: create a subclass of the Engine abstract class to implement a custom engine action
review_engine_registry: review the engine registry module that manages registration and execution of VISSL engine classes
